#### What this PR does / why we need it:
Adds preload of the Spark image into kind for SparkApplication tests, which prevents the runtime image pull that was causing the tests to flake.

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:
<!--
*Automatically closes linked issue when PR is merged.
Usage: `Fixes #<issue number>`, or `Fixes (paste link of issue)`.
_If PR is about `failing-tests or flakes`, please post the related issues/tests in a comment and do not use `Fixes`_*
-->
Fixes #11071

#### Special notes for your reviewer:
Added `/hack/testing/spark/Dockerfile` following aghost pattern of pinning an image version and referenced it in `.github/dependabot.yml`, sorted a list there alphabetically. 
Removed hardcoded spark image and version from testing utils.
Added optimization to prevent docker file parsing on each call for getting an image name. 
Also, suggesting to do the same for aghost image in follow up PR.

<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

This PR establishes Spark test image infrastructure for e2e tests by defining a Spark Dockerfile, updating e2e setup to initialize and load that image into test clusters, providing utilities to retrieve and parse image references, refactoring the SparkApplication builder to accept parameterized image and version values, and updating e2e tests to use those new parametrization capabilities.

## Changes

**Spark E2E Test Infrastructure**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Test Spark image definition and monitoring** <br> `hack/testing/spark/Dockerfile`, `.github/dependabot.yml`|New Dockerfile using `apache/spark:4.0.0` base image; Dependabot configuration updated to monitor the `/hack/testing/spark` directory path for updates.|
|**E2E environment image initialization and caching** <br> `hack/testing/e2e-common.sh`, `test/util/constants.go`|E2E common script conditionally derives `E2E_TEST_SPARK_IMAGE` from the Spark Dockerfile and exports it, pulls the image during Docker image preparation, and loads it into the kind cluster before Spark operator install. Package-level `sync.Once` cache and string storage support lazy memoization of the resolved image name.|
|**Image retrieval and version parsing utilities** <br> `test/util/e2e.go`|`GetSparkTestImage()` returns a memoized Spark test image reference (preferring `E2E_TEST_SPARK_IMAGE` env var or parsing the Dockerfile, with errors causing panic). `VersionFromImage()` utility extracts the version tag from an image reference by stripping digests and returning the substring after the last `:` when that `:` appears after the final `/`.|
|**SparkApplication builder flexible image and version** <br> `pkg/util/testingjobs/sparkapplication/wrappers_sparkapplication.go`|`MakeSparkApplication` factory no longer sets hardcoded `Spec.SparkVersion` and `Spec.Image` defaults. New fluent setter methods `Image(string)` and `SparkVersion(string)` allow post-construction customization of those fields.|
|**E2E test image parametrization** <br> `test/e2e/sequential/extended/sparkapplication_test.go`|Two SparkApplication e2e tests ("admitted" and "via TAS") now derive `sparkImage` via `util.GetSparkTestImage()`, apply it using `Image(sparkImage)`, and set the version using `SparkVersion(util.VersionFromImage(sparkImage))`.|

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~12 minutes

## Poem

> 🐰 A Spark is born in Docker's light,  
> Through e2e scripts it takes its flight,  
> With versioned builders, flexibly bound,  
> Test images found, all safely memoized and sound.

<details>
<summary>🧹 Nitpick comments (1)</summary><blockquote>

<details>
<summary>hack/testing/e2e-common.sh (1)</summary><blockquote>

`262-264`: _⚡ Quick win_

**Harden Spark image extraction for `FROM --platform=...` syntax.**

Current parsing assumes the image is always field 2. Valid Dockerfile syntax can place flags before the image, which would resolve the wrong value.





<details>
<summary>Proposed patch</summary>

```diff
-if [ -z "${E2E_TEST_SPARK_IMAGE:-}" ]; then
-  E2E_TEST_SPARK_IMAGE=$(grep '^FROM' "${ROOT_DIR}/hack/testing/spark/Dockerfile" | awk '{print $2}')
-  export E2E_TEST_SPARK_IMAGE=${E2E_TEST_SPARK_IMAGE%%@*}
-fi
+if [ -z "${E2E_TEST_SPARK_IMAGE:-}" ]; then
+  E2E_TEST_SPARK_IMAGE=$(
+    awk '
+      toupper($1)=="FROM" {
+        for (i=2; i<=NF; i++) {
+          if ($i !~ /^--/) { print $i; exit }
+        }
+      }
+    ' "${ROOT_DIR}/hack/testing/spark/Dockerfile"
+  )
+  export E2E_TEST_SPARK_IMAGE=${E2E_TEST_SPARK_IMAGE%%@*}
+fi
```
</details>
